description: For a table-type (Index PK_T), a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over T, and a snapshot over "SELECT N FROM T GROUP BY N": with no Edit, assign N the value 77, read Errors, the field Value and EditMode; then Edit where it is accepted, assign 77, Update, read Value; CancelUpdate. Asks whether and how a Value assignment outside Edit or AddNew is refused per type, and its effect on the buffer. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
